debug.diversity_summary: Within a zero-prop tight view, diversity is carried by ordinary support surfaces and settings: corporate desks, home workspace desks, home living-room tables, creative-office work tables, café tables, gaming desks, a classroom table, and a library study table. Visible object diversity is intentionally limited by the camera profile.
limitations: The camera profile allows zero local props and zero background details, so notebooks, papers, coffee cups, plants, shelving, people, and room-depth cues were removed even when present in C-Tech references.
Source activities such as sketching, presenting, video calls, collaboration, and sensitive work are mostly not visible because no people, devices, screens, or task materials can be included.
Café, Creative Studio, Education, and Gaming alternatives are less source-grounded than Office/Home; Education and Gaming are required category departures.
